mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lessons (instructor_id, name, description, bank_name, account_holder, account_number, period_weeks) VALUES (#{instructorId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{bankName}, #{accountHolder}, #{accountNumber}, #{periodWeeks})
INSERT INTO lesson_locations (lesson_id, type, region, address_detail) VALUES (#{lessonId}, #{type}, #{region}, #{addressDetail})
INSERT INTO lesson_prices (lesson_id, name, price) VALUES (#{lessonId}, #{name}, #{price})
INSERT INTO lesson_availabilities (lesson_id, day_of_week, start_time, end_time) VALUES (#{lessonId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{startTime}, #{endTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, instructor_id, name, description, bank_name, account_holder, account_number, period_weeks, created_at, updated_at FROM lessons WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, instructor_id, name, description, bank_name, account_holder, account_number, period_weeks, created_at, updated_at FROM lessons WHERE instructor_id = #{instructorId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, lesson_id, type, region, address_detail FROM lesson_locations WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, lesson_id, name, price FROM lesson_prices WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, lesson_id, day_of_week, start_time, end_time FROM lesson_availabilities WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} ORDER BY day_of_week, start_time
SELECT id, lesson_id, minutes FROM lesson_durations WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} ORDER BY minutes
